root.label: DACA active holders and renewal backlog June 2026

events.label: DACA active holders and renewal backlog June 2026

slots.name: active holders
slots.sentence: the number of active DACA holders declined by 14%, to 436,350, between September 2025 and June 30.

slots.name: renewal backlog
slots.sentence: the backlog of pending renewal applications has more than quadrupled over that timeframe, to over 125,000.

slots.name: processing rate
slots.sentence: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services says over the last six months, it adjudicated 80% of applications within seven months of submission.
